Senior 3D Visualizer — Emancipation Edutech (Remote)
As a 3D Animator, you will play a key role in visually translating ideas, concepts, and stories into engaging animated content for educational programs, cultural initiatives, marketing campaigns, and digital storytelling.
Key Responsibilities
- Create high-quality 3D animations for educational, cultural, and promotional content
- Develop storyboards, character animations, motion graphics, and visual narratives
- Collaborate with content, design, and marketing teams to align visuals with messaging
- Animate for social media, websites, presentations, and campaign assets
- Maintain visual consistency with brand guidelines
- Iterate and refine animations based on feedback and project requirements
Who We're Looking For
- Creative individuals with a strong foundation in 3D animation and visual storytelling
- Ability to convert concepts into compelling animated outputs
- High ownership, discipline, and commitment to deadlines
- 0–3 years of experience (Freshers welcome with a strong portfolio or demo reel)
Languages Required: English and Hindi
